Thiscord optional mono AEC3 neural residual estimator extension, 2026-10-02

Upstream: https://github.com/dignifiedquire/sonora, published crates 0.2.0
Source copied from crates.io source archives, retaining their license notices.
sonora 0.2.0 crates.io SHA-256: 2e1ce442ab5cb392c4067b8f2cced20be4cf12e479f6dfbf44acbe9b14ac9250
sonora-aec3 0.2.0 crates.io SHA-256: 50280e31256d09f7838aff6715ed4b7640e514dc1092a1e14013c01e552380db

These are patched third-party dependencies excluded from the three-package
first-party workspace. Cargo [patch.crates-io] ensures one Sonora implementation.
Other Sonora crates still come from the registry and remain pinned by Cargo.lock.
Model weights are embedded from frontend/models/ree-v2.tflite; none are stored
in this vendor directory or downloaded at build/runtime.

Changes:
- sonora-aec3/src/neural_residual.rs: optional Send + Debug estimator trait,
  aligned internal mono inputs, per-block residual/unbounded power outputs,
  reset and suppressor configuration hooks.
- sonora-aec3/src/{lib,block_processor,echo_remover}.rs: expose/inject estimator,
  reject non-mono configurations, advance its history, select valid estimates
  only with a usable linear filter, reset after audio-path changes.
- sonora-aec3/src/residual_echo_estimator.rs: update the omission comment;
  the conventional algorithm is unchanged.
- sonora/src/{lib,audio_processing,audio_processing_impl,echo_canceller3}.rs:
  propagate public injection to AEC3. APM configuration rebuild drops the hook;
  the frontend owns, resets and reattaches its model without filesystem I/O.

With no estimator injected, conventional processing is unchanged. This is a
focused extension of Sonora 0.2.0, not a complete current C++ AEC3 port. Neural
suppression tuning applies while the estimator is installed, including startup;
classical residual estimation is retained until linear adaptation is usable.
Application inference/feature extraction remains in frontend's neural_echo module.
That module follows WebRTC revision 526e228d25f83b1023760d3835f33d622c7b9f5f;
see WEBRTC_LICENSE.txt, WEBRTC_PATENTS.txt and TENSORFLOW_LICENSE.txt. Copies are
included in the desktop's THIRD_PARTY_AUDIO.txt resource.

Updating Sonora: compare these files against the new registry source; rebase the
hook deliberately, preserve PCM scale/reference alignment and failure behavior,
and rerun conventional and neural regression suites, reference parity and full
pipeline benchmarks. Do not blindly overwrite this directory during dependency
updates. Review upstream support before retaining the patch indefinitely.

Checks: docs/voice-isolation.md records commands, model hash, reference interpreter,
local measurements and remaining real-device/provenance acceptance. Native CI runs
regressions using the bundled model and builds on three platforms.
